outlet: VoteWA election results, Ferry County, August 4, 2026 primary
notes: Ferry County primary results (fully reported, as of 2026-09-11): County Commissioner #2 counted in 7 of 19 reporting units (Berry 539, Dean 294, Adams 185); every other county office in 19 of 19: Clerk Breezee 1,200, Mott 851; Sheriff Olson 1,281, Maycumber 995. Resolution 2025-03 (6 units) 671-292 and Resolution 2025-04 (2 units) 178-94 were the primary's two EMS levies (EMS District 1 and City of Republic).
